name: pigify-workspace
description: Pigify Swine Disease & Clinical Telemetry System for Backyard Farms

scripts.setup:env: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['backend', 'frontend', 'mobile'].forEach(dir => { const envPath = dir + '/.env'; const examplePath = dir + '/.env.example'; if (!fs.existsSync(envPath) && fs.existsSync(examplePath)) { fs.copyFileSync(examplePath, envPath); console.log('Created ' + envPath + ' from .env.example'); } else { console.log(envPath + ' already exists or is ready.'); } });"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix mobile install
